meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: "Edit Evaluation Time": "Cancel" closes it and changes nothing
warnings: resolved: “Directly compare the RFQ's submission and evaluation time values before and after cancelling the dialog.” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

plan.title: Cancel Edit Evaluation Time on Live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with one vendor bid.
Record the event's live status before opening the evaluation-time dialog.
Verify the responding vendor is present before the cancellation test.
Verify the existing bid is present before the cancellation test.
Open the RFQ Settings action that launches the Edit Evaluation Time window.
Confirm the Edit Evaluation Time window opened.
Cancel the evaluation-time edit without saving changes.
Assert that cancelling closes the Edit Evaluation Time window.
Verify the event remains live after cancellation.
Verify the vendor remains unchanged after cancellation.
Verify the existing bid remains unchanged after cancellation.
